preconditions.expression: isinstance(n, int) and isinstance(m, int) and 1 <= n <= 1000 and 1 <= m <= 1000 and 1 <= n * m <= 200000
preconditions.description: The dimensions n and m are integers within the specified bounds, and their product does not exceed 200,000.

preconditions.expression: len(grid) == n and all(len(row) == m for row in grid)
preconditions.description: The input grid contains exactly n rows, each with exactly m integers.

preconditions.expression: set(val for row in grid for val in row) == set(range(1, n * m + 1))
preconditions.description: The grid values form a permutation of integers from 1 to n*m.

postconditions.expression: isinstance(output_count, int) and output_count == sum(1 for l in range(1, n * m + 1) for r in range(l, n * m + 1) if is_pleasant_segment(grid, n, m, l, r))
postconditions.description: The output is the count of all pairs (l, r) with 1 <= l <= r <= n*m such that the set of cells with values in [l, r] forms a connected subgraph where every pair of nodes has exactly one simple path within the set (i.e., the induced subgraph is a tree).
